title: Jumble
description: A Jumble's /metrics: the community at a glance and at work, activity, email and notifications, background work, requests, backups and the JVM.

list.name: Restarts
list.textFormat: A deploy, or the app restarting after a failure

panels.title: Members
panels.description: Accounts not deleted.

panels.title: Backups
panels.description: Whether Litestream, which backs the database up, answers.

panels.title: Oldest email waiting
panels.description: How long the email due first has waited. Over an hour: email is stuck.

panels.title: Background failures (1h)
panels.description: Failed runs of background steps (notifications, outbox, reminders, storage) in the last hour.

panels.title: Up for
panels.description: Since the app last started.

panels.title: Disk free
panels.description: Share of the database's disk still free. Under a tenth: make room.

panels.title: Reports waiting
panels.description: Listings with reports no moderator has handled yet.

panels.title: Found a new home (7 days)
panels.description: Listings sold, given away or found in the last week: the community at work.

panels.title: Conversations started (7 days)
panels.description: Members writing to someone about a listing for the first time, in the last week.

panels.title: Emails failed (24 hours)
panels.description: Emails the mail server refused or could not take; they are retried.

panels.title: Server errors (1 hour)
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a server error.

panels.title: Listings posted, messages, sign-ins (per hour)
panels.description: Counted since the app started; restarts are taken into account.

panels.title: How listings end (per day)
panels.description: Listings leaving the board each day: sold, given away or found is the community working; expired means nobody wanted them.

panels.title: New members (per day)
panels.description: Members joined, less accounts deleted, over each day.

panels.title: Reports waiting
panels.description: Listings with reports waiting for a moderator.

panels.title: Outbox
panels.description: Emails waiting (never tried), retrying (failed before) and given up on.

panels.title: Since each step last succeeded
panels.description: Steps run every few seconds; a line climbing means a step keeps failing.

panels.title: Photos waiting to be deleted from storage
Emails (per hour)
panels.description: Emails handed to the mail server, sent or failed.

panels.title: Browser notifications (per hour)
panels.description: Notifications to members' devices: sent, gone (the device unsubscribed), failed (retried) or dropped (read meanwhile).

panels.title: Chat announcements (per hour)
panels.description: New posts announced to the community's chat channel: sent, failed (retried) or dropped (off the board, too old, or refused by the webhook: see the log).

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(jumble_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job"}[1h]))))

panels.title: Disk (database volume)
panels.description: Free space on the disk holding the database; it should stay well above the database and its log.
